title: Intratumoral Monocyte Transfer to Examine Monocyte Differentiation in the Tumor Microenvironment
protocol: Spray hindlimbs of euthanized mouse with 70% ethanol (EtOH).
Remove overlying skin and muscle from the femur and tibia.
Amputate femur from the ileum, separate femur from tibia, separate tibia from hind foot.
Carefully preserve epiphyses of femur and tibia to ensure maximum bone marrow extraction.
Cut proximal epiphyses of bones.
Flush the bone shafts with 5 mL MACS buffer using a 27G needle.
Disaggregate and transfer flushed bone marrow into a 50 mL conical tube using an 18G needle.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 8 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant from the cell pellet formed by the bone marrow cells.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 2 mL of 1× RBC Lysis Buffer and incubate on ice for 5 minutes to lyse red blood cells.
Quench the lysis reaction by adding 10 mL MACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 8 minutes at 4°C.
Resuspend the cell pellet in MACS buffer.
Take an aliquot of the resuspended cells for counting.
Follow the Miltenyi Mouse BM Monocyte Isolation Kit protocol to magnetically label bone marrow cells and perform column-based enrichment of monocytes.
Wash isolated monocytes twice with 1× PBS.
Resuspend 5 × 10^5 monocytes in 50 μL of 1× PBS.
Draw monocytes up into a 27G needle with a 0.5 inch length.
Remove any air bubbles present in the syringe.
Induce general anesthesia using isoflurane gas for the recipient mouse.
Place the syringe on a slow-moving shaker at 15°C–25°C while preparing the mouse for injection.
Inject 50 μL of monocytes/PBS into the flank tumor at a 45° angle with the bevel up.
Scruff the mouse to ensure the skin is held taut during injection.
Spray euthanize mouse with 70% EtOH.
Remove skin layer overlying the flank tumor.
Excise entire flank tumor from underlying muscle and adipose tissue.
Place tumor into petri dish.
Mince tumor into small pieces (1–3 mm).
Transfer minced tissue to container containing a magnetic stir bar.
Add 5 ml of tumor dissociation buffer containing Collagenase B (2 mg/ml) and DNase I (40 U/ml) in DMEM media.
Prepare fresh solution of Collagenase B and DNase I media.
Place container with tissue, media, and stir bar onto stir plate in 37°C incubator.
Let stir at low to medium speed for 30–45 min.
Dissociate tumors based on their stromal content for an optimal time determined empirically.
Pass dissociated tumor suspension through a 70 μm filter placed on top of a 50 mL conical tube.
Wash the filter with 10 mL of DMEM media.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 8 min at 4°C.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet in 2 mL of 1× RBC Lysis Buffer and incubate for 5 min on ice to lyse red blood cells.
Quench the lysis by adding 10 mL of MACS buffer.
Centrifuge at 300 × g for 8 min at 4°C.
Aspirate supernatant.
Enrich intratumoral leukocytes using a column-based positive selection kit following the Miltenyi Mouse CD45 MicroBeads protocol to select for CD45+ cells in mouse tumors.
Centrifuge the CD45 enriched fraction at 300 × g for 8 min at 4°C.
Aspirate supernatant.
Resuspend cell pellet in 1 mL MACS buffer and take an aliquot for cell counting.
Resuspend 1–2 × 106 cells in 100 μL of MACS buffer.
Add anti-mouse CD16/32 Fc Block at a final dilution of 1:200.
Keep the cell suspension on ice.
Prepare an antibody cocktail as specified for flow cytometry analysis.
Mix the prepared antibody cocktail with the cells and vortex briefly.
Incubate the mixture in the dark at 4°C for 30 minutes.
Wash the cells with 1 mL of MACS buffer.
Centrifuge the sample at 300 × g for 8 minutes at 4°C.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend cells in 200 μL of MACS buffer.
Add 5 μL of 7AAD cell viability dye to each sample.
Keep samples in the dark.
Run samples on a flow cytometer.
